summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat described the $1,000 gold and silver champion belt, made by Eugene Jaccard & Co., to be presented to Tom Allen that night at the Theater Comique and shown at his May 10 fight with Mace.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Daily Democrat, Saturday Morning, April 30, 1870.

facts.fact: Allen was presented a $1,000 champion belt of five gold and five silver plates, made by Eugene Jaccard & Co. and inscribed 'Presented to Thomas Allen by his St. Louis friends', at an exhibition at the Theater Comique
Allen and Jem Mace were to meet in the ring near New Orleans on May 10, 1870

notes: Fact 021 gives April 29, 1870; this article says the belt was to be presented 'to-night', Saturday April 30. The article describes a planned presentation, not the event itself.
